mouse_branched_ductal_network_specimen.species: Mus musculus (embryonic mouse branched epithelial ductal network whole-mount fluorescence micrograph showing cyan/green active distal tips A at the invading periphery and blue/magenta differentiated ductal trails I)

hannezo_2017_barw_governing_model.section: Hannezo et al. (2017) Cell 171:242-255 STAR Methods Eqs. (1)-(12) & Scheele et al. (2017) Nature 542:313-317

governing_equations.stochastic_barw_rules: A ->(k_b) 2A (tip bifurcation);  A ->(v_0) A + I (ductal trail deposition);  A + I ->(R_a) I (tip-duct steric/TGF-beta annihilation)
governing_equations.mean_field_active_tip_pde: da/dt = D * laplacian(a) - v0 * div(u_p * a) + kb * a - ka * a * (a + i)
governing_equations.homeostatic_steady_state: a_inf = 0 (behind invading wave),   i_inf = c_0 * kb / ka  propto  kb / (v0 * Ra)
governing_equations.topological_tree_balance: N_term = N_branch + 1  =>  q_branch = N_branch / (N_branch + N_term) = N_branch / (2 * N_branch + 1) -> 1/2

perturbation_and_ablation_benchmarks.description: Wild-type TGF-beta / steric tip-duct annihilation (Ra = 3.5, kb = 0.12)
Attenuated TGF-beta / reduced annihilation radius (Ra = 1.75, 2x hyper-dense ductal filling)
Elevated TGF-beta / enlarged annihilation radius (Ra = 7.0, sparse hypoplastic ductal network)
Non-annihilating pure Galton-Watson branching ablation (Ra = 0, ka = 0): unarrested exponential tip explosion and duct crossovers
